row.notes: Finds the player tyre component, locates the compound record (0x18-stride table at component+0x9bd0, count +0x9c48) for the index, localises its name and binds it to the named slot "compound" in the formatter at vm+0x880; writes the laps value picked by programme type vm+0xe60 into vm+0xc00. Chooses the format "[compound], [unavailable]" (state 2), "[compound], [reserved]" (state 1) or "[compound], [laps] [laps_string]" with " ([recommended])" appended when the index equals the recommended index for the programme (vm+0x6250..+0x6264). Returns the formatted string, empty when no player car.
